title: initial-plan-review.v1
description: Initial plan review record written through the review port. Binds one envelope fingerprint and authorized terminal intent. Proves that strategy, safety, dependencies, and scope alignment were reviewed against one reviewed-execution-envelope.v1. Does not pin later task text; task edits inside the envelope need no approval. Missing, rejected, wrong-envelope, or wrong-intent review blocks projection.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Review policy owns the gate; a new envelope or intent needs fresh review. Unknown versions refuse.

review_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this initial plan review record.

envelope_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the reviewed-execution-envelope.v1 this review binds. A changed envelope invalidates this review.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the reviewed baseline plan. Audit provenance only; grants no continuing authority to its task list.

authorized_terminal_intent.description: Explicitly authorized terminal intent for this envelope. A changed intent requires fresh review.

reviewer.description: Named reviewer who performed the initial plan review.

identity.description: Reviewer identity (no real names, emails, or personal identifiers in repository artifacts).

decision.description: Review decision. Only accepted reviews enable projection for this envelope and intent.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant when this review was recorded.
